reviews.text: I just received an order that I had placed with this company, and it is absolutely first class. Not only is the quality of the work top notch, the owner of the company, Gary Childres is one of the best people I have ever dealt with. I definitely recommend them. Thanks again.
reviews.author: Dennis Bucher

reviews.text:
This company is small and independently owned.  The owner is very helpful and professional.  He spends time with the customers to assist in selecting what is needed.  They custom made the screens for the PEGOLA on my patio.  It is beautiful, well-done, durable, and easy to control the opening and closing.
I highly recommend this company.
reviews.author: Linda Ellis

reviews.text: We have been working with Childres for over 8 months now and still have't resolved issues from their original installation.  Although there has has been quality control issues with the installation workmanship, the biggest issue is communication from the company.  Everyone from the owner, to the receptionists to the work crews have a significant lack of follow up.  I can't count the number of times that we have confirmed repair dates recorded via e-mail and they don't show up.  No call - No show is their mantra.  The owner has even given me his cell phone, promised work, and hasn't shown up.
reviews.author: Joshua Boschee

reviews.text: Paid for a canvas product that was manufactured incorrectly and the owner would not refund or replace the item. Buyer be ware, these folks put us in a bind and offered no remedy. I had to place an order other a different company to resolve the issue.
reviews.author: Terry Williams

reviews.text: I thought I could not go wrong using local hometown owner. I failed to check reviews. Not even a year old and welds are coming apart and structure is collapsing. Owner will not follow through on repairs after purchase.
reviews.author: Mary Jones

reviews.text: They made a pool cover for us and installed it too. It was perfectly made and the service was top notch. I highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Dana Davidson

reviews.text: Had a porch enclosed over a year ago. It looks very good however there is finish work that needs to be done that has been waiting for over a year and after multiple calls to Childress.
reviews.author: Kevin Carkin

data.summary: Reviews appear authentic and paint a consistent picture of a business with quality workmanship but severe customer service and post-sale support failures. The pattern of complaints about unfulfilled repairs and poor communication is strong and repeated across multiple negative reviews over many years. Positive reviews praise the owner and product quality, but negative experiences are detailed and credible.
fake_signals: No reviews on HQ Google listing suggests low volume
Lack of reviews on major contractor platforms (Angi, Houzz)
authentic_signals: Specific project details (pool cover, pergola screens, porch enclosure)
Detailed complaints with timelines and specific failures
Varied writing styles and timeframes (reviews span 11 years)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistent across Google and Yelp, both indicating an average, mixed-reputation business.
